digest.component_or_area: authorship verification and commit history resolution
propositions: Compacted authorship-ledger entries retain pre-rewrite commit SHAs; after history rewrite these SHAs become stale while event positions remain valid, causing the verifier to misclassify authentic ledger entries.
The verifier must treat stored ledger commit_sha as a cache and prefer the commit resolved from the current position, falling back to the recorded SHA only when position resolution fails.
A real-Git regression must prove that signed events in a compacted ledger with non-null pre-rewrite commit SHAs are correctly verified after history rewrite changes all commit SHAs.
Live-event authorship behavior, ledger schema, event bytes, and existing null-commit recovery must remain unchanged by the fix.
